## L001 — The Trap in the River: How Đại Việt Beat Kublai Khan's Fleet (1288)

**Description**

```
In 1288, a Yuan fleet sent by Kublai Khan was destroyed on the Bạch Đằng River in northern Vietnam, caught on wooden stakes driven into the riverbed. Archaeologists have since found three stake yards near Quảng Yên. What can the mud prove, what can't it prove, and why did the winner still send tribute?
```
